title: Eighteenmile 2023 trace metals — selected original observations
sections: This edition contains 153 original results from 17 sampling activities at 5 stations. Station: all; metal: all; result: all; month: all; search: none; chart: Iron.
Every result retains its original station/activity/source-row identity, reported value and unit, quantification limit and unit, analytical method, fraction, collection metadata and source comments.

The quantified ranges use reported values only within each displayed metal/method/unit/fraction group. Below-limit rows retain blank reported-value fields and their original limits. The same-activity chemistry context is presented using its own original basis.
Stations were sampled on different schedules. Calendar overlap identifies calendar support and does not equate distinct activities or collection times.

The following observations share each metal activity's exact organization, station, project and activity identity. Original result fraction and units remain visible; no hardness-basis conversion is applied.
The selected original metal rows have blank result, activity and laboratory comment fields. Blank original collection method/equipment fields remain blank in the complete selected CSV.
Original analytical method names, method descriptions, detection-limit type, result status and all 73 normalized source/context fields remain in selected-records.csv.
